lead_headline: Restaurant tracker logs just one confirmed closure today — but subscriptions surge +6 net on 7 new signups, best single-day gain since July 29.

restaurant.blurb: 1 closure today — Solutions Lounge shuttered in Five Points (February 2026). Active leads now 315 total (165 openings, 150 closures).

liquor.blurb: Zero applications filed — eight consecutive business days without activity extends unprecedented drought into second full week. Weekly count stuck at zero, down from prior week's still-dismal 5 (which had fallen 94% from the week before that). Month-end total reflects sustained paralysis: either the state's batch-processing cadence has stretched to multi-week intervals or fundamental intake throttling has taken hold. August's opening days will determine whether July's collapse marks structural shift or extreme anomaly.

reputation.blurb: 29 mentions this week across 10 sources — down 64% from prior week's 81, marking second consecutive sharp decline and lowest weekly total since early June. Facebook led with 8 citations (28% share), Instagram followed at 7, Denver Post contributed 5. Building Salt Lake covered Alterra ski headquarters relocation story; Denver Post ran Fire on the Mountain Central Park opening; Union Station preservation content sustained engagement. Week averaged just 4.1 mentions/day vs. prior 11.6 — steep two-week slide suggests either summer doldrums or post-peak normalization after spring surge. YTD 1,167 total from 111 sources.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +6 yesterday (7 new, 1 canceled) — strongest single-day gain since July 29's +5, lifts August to flat after one day (+0.0/day), 90-day net to +102. Last two weeks show divergent momentum: prior seven delivered +14 net on mid-week acquisition spikes (11 new on 7/23, 10 on 7/28); latest seven posted +20 net on sustained momentum (9 net on 7/28, 5 on 7/29, 6 today). July closed as weakest month since March at −16 net, but August opens with promising velocity — if pace holds, month could reverse July's decline and restore annual trajectory. YTD +216 (+1.0/day) intact.
